data.one_liner: Unofficial Dart and Flutter SDK for the OpenAI API and compatible providers.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed clients for OpenAI and compatible APIs like DeepSeek, Ollama, and LM Studio. It supports chat completions, streaming, vector stores, fine-tuning, images, audio, and more across all platforms including web.
use_when: You need to integrate OpenAI or compatible LLM APIs into your Dart or Flutter app.
You require multi-platform support including Flutter Web.
You need robust streaming, automatic retries, and rate-limit tracking.
avoid_when: You are building exclusively with official first-party SDKs that have guaranteed OpenAI synchronization.
You require only on-device models without any remote API connectivity.
strengths: Comprehensive API coverage including Responses, Chat, Realtime, Batch, and Vector Stores.
Per-client configuration allows multiple accounts or local models to run side-by-side.
Platform-neutral file handling supports web and native disk access.
weaknesses: It is an unofficial SDK, meaning it might lag behind official OpenAI API updates.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure your OpenAI API key or compatible endpoint URL.

alternatives.name: ollama_dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you are specifically targeting Ollama local models and want an Ollama-focused client.

alternatives.name: openai_dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative Dart client for the OpenAI API.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you want to run Llama models directly on-device rather than calling a remote API.
